fusions.name: Cold Jaws
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 28 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Chained Snarl
fusions.desc: Snaps at every enemy within 3 tiles, which deals 10 damage, strips 20% armour for 6 seconds and slows each by 10%, then stuns each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Guardpost Plating
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Guard Duty
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
